LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingRelayMastLosses: Relay masts wear and can be raided
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingRelayMastLossesDesc: Off by default. On: a relay mast left on the world map wears in the weather and stops passing calls on after about a year until a convoy services it, and raiders from a hostile settlement nearby may knock it down, more often the nearer it stands. Relay posts are left to the outposts mod's own raids.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayConditionWornOut: Worn out ({CONDITION}): it passes nothing on until a convoy services it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayWornOut: {MAST} is worn out and passes nothing on until a convoy services it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayRaided: Raiders of {FACTION} found {MAST} and knocked it down. Calls no longer pass through it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayServiceGizmoDesc: Tighten its stays, clean its panel and replace what has worn, with {COUNT} component from the convoy's cargo. It is as good as new.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayServiceShort: It needs {COUNT} component from the convoy's cargo.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayServiced: {MAST} is serviced and as good as new.
